data.long_description:
Provident Estate is proud to present this exceptional 2-bedroom apartment for rent in Volante, Business Bay, offering an unparalleled level of luxury in one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront developments. Spanning an impressive 5,043.32 sq. ft., this residence is designed for those who appreciate space, elegance, and exclusivity, with stunning canal and city views.

Property Highlights:

2 Spacious Bedrooms
3 Modern Bathrooms
Expansive 5,043.32 sq. ft. layout
Floor-to-ceiling windows with canal & skyline views
High-end finishes and premium materials
Fully equipped contemporary kitchen
Large living and dining areas
Built-in wardrobes
Bright and naturally lit interiors

Community Amenities
Residents of Volante enjoy world-class facilities designed for comfort and convenience, including:

State-of-the-art fitness center
Luxury spa and wellness facilities
Swimming pool
Valet service
24/7 concierge and security
Exclusive and private residential environment

Location Highlights:

Ideally located in the heart of Business Bay, the property offers seamless connectivity to key areas in Dubai. Residents benefit from close proximity to Downtown Dubai, major road networks, fine dining restaurants, and premium retail outlets, ensuring a vibrant and convenient lifestyle.
data.title: 2 bedroom apartment to rent
